name: Gulf Island Grill
description: Established in 2003 by Freddie and Pat Peninger, Gulf Island Grill is known for its unique tropical flavors and world famous smoked ribs! We provide dine-in or carry out. From snowbirds to spring breakers, we guarantee you'll be satisfied. Fresh seafood and savory burgers served everyday. Our drink menu has a variety of tropical cocktails, creamy bushwackers, and local craft beers to choose from!
